question: Who among the following was the second ruler of the Mauryan empire?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bindusara.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bindusara succeeded his father Chandragupta Maurya.
 
• Under Bindusara, the Mauryan Empire is said to have expanded further south.
 
• His Greek name, Amitrochates (or Amitrochades), which translates as "the slayer of foes."
 
• He was succeeded by his son "Ashoka."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mauryan Empire:** was founded by **Chandragupta Maurya **with the help of **Chanakya.**
 
• The capital of the Mauryan Empire was **Pataliputra (present-day Patna)**.
 
• The Mauryan Empire has **trade connections **with regions like **Greece, Persia, Central Asia, and Southeast Asia.**
 
• Ashoka's patronage led to the significant spread of **Buddhism.**
 
• By 185 BCE, the last **Mauryan ruler, Brihadratha**, was overthrown by his general, **Pushyamitra Shunga**, leading to the establishment of the **Shunga Dynasty.**
